# Lightweight Charts

Pinned standalone browser runtime: **5.2.0**, Apache-2.0, distributed by TradingView.

Source: https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts/tree/v5.2.0

The npm tarball integrity was verified before extraction:
`sha512-ey3Vas8UhV06ni+LT9TA1nEe4y8So4Mi6CL/oarNHFMyTktz/xy8e8+oh04Q//eO3t6etvFXgayz2fClyFQb5w==`

LICENSE and NOTICE are retained. Native charts display the TradingView attribution
logo and an attribution link. The library supplies rendering; T-IOS implements
its own feed adapter, drawing tools, indicators and account persistence.
